releases.name: v0.11.0 — AI Studio 0.3.2-magpie.1, Gemini Web backend 4.27.1-magpie.1
releases.body:
## Backends

- **Managed AI Studio [0.3.2-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/studio-v0.3.2-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v0.3.2` (`4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f`). Includes upstream v0.3.1 and v0.3.2: content-policy finish reasons (SAFETY, RECITATION, …) are now returned as errors carrying the upstream reason instead of a silently truncated reply, Build model tool-call continuation, daily-limit cooldown fallback, Omni inline images/video, faster long-text and worker cold start, AVX2/NEON media encoding and libwebp 1.6.0. Both Magpie patches carry over unchanged; the new `HIDE_DOCK_ICON` setting is preserved from the admin page and isolated from the host environment. Camoufox is unchanged, so upgrading does not download it again. (#48, #49)
- **Gemini Web backend [4.27.1-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/backend-v4.27.1-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v4.27.1`. Canned failure replies ("Sorry, something went wrong…") are detected before any text is streamed and retried; `tool_call` arguments are always a JSON object (no more `"arguments": "null"` / "must be a JSON object" errors in agent runs); web UI component tags (`<Sequence>`, `<Carousel>`, …) are rendered as Markdown; the dead `image_generation_content` placeholder link is removed from image replies. The official rollback channel (`npm run backend:install:upstream`) now pins upstream `v4.27.1`. (#50)

## Upgrade

Install the attached `magpie-gemini-web-0.11.0.tgz` or update through npm. Stop any running managed `gemini-web2api-go` or `AIStudio2API` process (`npm run studio:stop` / `npm run backend:stop`); the next managed start upgrades the binary while keeping your accounts and settings. Users of the 0.10.0 plugin move from AI Studio 0.3.0-magpie.1 directly to 0.3.2-magpie.1.

## Validation

- All 222 tests (220 passed, 2 skipped) at the release commit `ce41cb3a60c79b4da65aae008d0a9757dd8bc7e8`.
- All five native AI Studio runners ([run 42460565674](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460565674)) and all six native Gemini Web backend runners ([run 42460562002](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460562002)) rebuilt from pinned sources, matched SHA-256 pins, and passed isolated installation smoke tests.

Full changelog: https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

releases.name: AI Studio 0.3.2-magpie.1
releases.body:
AI Studio backend based on upstream v0.3.2 (`4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f`), managed exclusively by the Magpie plugin.

- **Upstream v0.3.2 (`4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f`):** content-policy finish reasons (safety, recitation, blocklist, prohibited content, SPII and their image variants) are now reported as errors with the upstream reason; Build model tool-call continuation; daily-limit cooldown fallback; Omni inline images and video; attachment preview and video frame extraction settings; long-text, worker cold-start and Camoufox page performance fixes. Also includes everything from upstream v0.3.1 (AVX2/NEON image and audio encoding, libwebp 1.6.0 lossy WebP, crash and warm sign-in fixes, 10-second streaming heartbeats).
- **New `HIDE_DOCK_ICON` setting:** the value saved in the admin page is preserved and host environment variables of the same name are isolated from the managed service. It only affects the upstream desktop build; the managed build is still built without the `desktop` tag.
- **Managed configuration (`patches/studio-0.2.19-managed-config.patch`) and safe request-body migration (`patches/studio-0.2.17-preserve-request-bodies.patch`):** both apply unchanged to `v0.3.2`.

Source: upstream commit `4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f` plus the two patches recorded in `build.json`. Go 1.27.1, Camoufox 152.0.4-beta.29, SpiderMonkey v152.0.4-aistudio2api.1, libwebp v1.6.0-aistudio2api.1, Zig 0.16.0 (Linux), llvm-mingw 20261020 (Windows), Xcode 26.3 (macOS). Build instructions: `docs/studio-release.md`.

Validation: all five native runners in [the verification workflow](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460565674) passed at the release commit `ce41cb3a60c79b4da65aae008d0a9757dd8bc7e8`.

releases.name: Optimized backend 4.27.1-magpie.1
releases.body:
Ready-to-run optimized backend for **macOS, Linux and Windows, on x64 and arm64**, built from upstream v4.27.1 with `patches/argon.patch`.

New in this backend (from upstream v4.27.1, merged into the Magpie patch):

- **Failure-reply retries (upstream #68).** Upstream occasionally answers HTTP 200 with a canned failure sentence ("I seem to be encountering an error…", "Sorry, something went wrong…"). These replies (`inner[31]` set) are now detected before any text reaches the client and retried, on both single-turn and `multi_turn` paths. Retry waits stay cancellable, so a disconnected client still stops the request, and failure replies are not counted against proxy health.
- **Tool-call argument normalization (upstream #69).** `tool_call` arguments are always emitted as a JSON object (`{}` when absent) instead of `"null"`; arguments under `parameters` / `input` / `args`, flattened at the top level, or JSON-encoded as a string are accepted, as are `tool` / `tool_name` / `function.name` for the tool name. Early tool-call completion recognizes the same names.
- **Web UI markup rendering.** `<Sequence>`, `<Carousel>`, `<ElicitationsGroup>`, `<FollowUp>` and `<TemplateWidget>` tags in replies are converted to Markdown (streaming included; code fences are left untouched).
- **Image placeholder cleanup.** The unusable `http://googleusercontent.com/image_generation_content/0_N` line is removed from image-generation replies; images are still attached at the end.
- Everything from 4.27.0-magpie.2 carries over: `authuser` (`/u/N/`) support, XSRF caching, silence-based chat timing (180 s of silence by default), early tool-call completion, cancellation propagation, Argon model verification, account proxy binding and the one-time `web_channel` warning.

## Build provenance

- Upstream: [zexadev/gemini-web2api-go@c8a4ac2](https://github.com/zexadev/gemini-web2api-go/commit/c8a4ac25768b668fa94d293fcb97059c4419b602) (`v4.27.1`)
- Patch: `patches/argon.patch` (SHA-256 `92d9b418123d14d5de32ce393d6c707bdadc9da801637959bb44b0cee5771f7b`, also recorded in `build.json`)
- Go: `1.27.1`, `CGO_ENABLED=0`, `-trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags="-s -w"`
- Reported backend version: `4.27.1-magpie.1`
- Included: six executables, patched source archive, `build.json`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and `LICENSE-UPSTREAM`.

## Validation

All seven jobs in [the release verification workflow](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460562002) passed at the release commit `ce41cb3a60c79b4da65aae008d0a9757dd8bc7e8`.

releases.name: v0.10.0 — AI Studio 0.3.0-magpie.1, Deep Research models & asset cleanup
releases.body:
## Backends

- **Managed AI Studio [0.3.0-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/studio-v0.3.0-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v0.3.0` + PR #109 (`48f75fa722b25d22a493e75f6d4e5f9d5035d7e3`). Sign-in and re-login now run as background tasks (`/api/accounts/tasks`) that survive HTTP timeouts and close the Camoufox login window cleanly on cancellation. Adds local Chrome / Cookie / CDP browser account imports, automatic compression/restoration for tool function names over 63 characters, `STRIP_THOUGHT_SIGNATURES`, and state persistence (`runtime/states.db`). (#47)
- **Gemini Web backend [4.27.0-magpie.2](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/backend-v4.27.0-magpie.2)**, based on upstream `v4.27.0`. Logs the ignored `web_channel` configuration warning once per process instead of on every config parse, and re-reads usage and email immediately when an account's `authuser` index changes. (#43)

## Features & Changes

- **Deep Research models in AI Studio (`deep-research-preview-04-2026`, `deep-research-max-preview-04-2026`).** Listed when signed in with a Google AI Pro / Ultra account (`magpie provider models ai-studio`). Calls stream over `/v1/chat/completions` (`reasoning_content` progress updates followed by the Markdown research report and citations) via AIStudio2API's Interactions bridge, with `toolcall: false` and `temperature: false`. (#45, #46)
- **Automatic cleanup of downloaded binaries on plugin removal.** Removing the plugin in Magpie (or running `npm run studio:clean` / `npm run backend:clean`) stops the local services and removes downloaded `AIStudio2API`, `Camoufox` and `gemini-web2api-go` binaries/archives while preserving accounts and configuration (`auth/`, `gemini.db`, `config.json`, `.env`, `secrets.json`). (#44)

## Upgrade

Install the attached `magpie-gemini-web-0.10.0.tgz` or update through npm. Stop any running managed `gemini-web2api-go` or `AIStudio2API` process (`npm run studio:stop` / `npm run backend:stop`); the next managed start upgrades the binary while keeping your accounts and settings. Run `magpie provider models ai-studio` to refresh the AI Studio model list.

## Validation

- All 222 tests passed at the release commit `af0ccfc18dd6116e4c80004a2658679cdfacd9d7`.
- All five native AI Studio runners ([run 42010765010](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42010765010)) and all six native Gemini Web backend runners ([run 42010772352](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42010772352)) rebuilt from pinned sources, matched SHA-256 pins, and passed isolated installation smoke tests.
- Live E2E tested with a Google AI Ultra account on `deep-research-preview-04-2026` over `/v1/chat/completions` streaming.

Full changelog: https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0

releases.name: AI Studio 0.3.0-magpie.1
releases.body:
AI Studio backend based on upstream v0.3.0 (`48f75fa722b25d22a493e75f6d4e5f9d5035d7e3`), managed exclusively by the Magpie plugin.

- **Upstream v0.3.0 + PR #109 (`48f75fa722b25d22a493e75f6d4e5f9d5035d7e3`):** background asynchronous account sign-in/re-login tasks (`/api/accounts/tasks`), local Chrome / Cookie / CDP browser account import, automatic compression and restoration of tool function names longer than 63 characters, `STRIP_THOUGHT_SIGNATURES`, state persistence (`runtime/states.db`), and default `WAA_BACKEND=spidermonkey`.
- **Managed configuration (`patches/studio-0.2.19-managed-config.patch`):** updated for `v0.3.0`'s `workerDefaultKeys` (`WARM_WORKER_LIMIT`, `MAX_ACTIVE_WORKERS`) and `STRIP_THOUGHT_SIGNATURES`. When built with `internal/config.managedBy=magpie-gemini-web`, the backend skips legacy `.env` rewrites and saves editable settings explicitly while keeping environment-controlled settings locked.
- **Safe request-body migration (`patches/studio-0.2.17-preserve-request-bodies.patch`):** unchanged.

Source: upstream commit `48f75fa722b25d22a493e75f6d4e5f9d5035d7e3` plus the two patches recorded in `build.json`. Go 1.27.1, Camoufox 152.0.4-beta.29, SpiderMonkey v152.0.4-aistudio2api.1, Zig 0.16.0 (Linux), llvm-mingw 20261020 (Windows), Xcode 26.3 (macOS). Build instructions: `docs/studio-release.md`.

Validation: all five native runners in [the verification workflow](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42010765010) passed at the release commit `af0ccfc18dd6116e4c80004a2658679cdfacd9d7`.
